hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-001.text: Isiphepho sangempela kulobu busuku. Uma udonsa i-caravan, i-caravan yiyona eshayelayo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-001.en: Proper gale tonight. If you're towing a caravan, the caravan is driving.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-002.text: Kushisa ngempela ntambama. Ngisho namakhandlela awakwazi ukuma aqonde.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-002.en: Proper heat this afternoon. Even the candles can't stand up straight.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-003.text: Isithwathwa emthunzini. Ulayini webhasi usungene elangeni.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-003.en: Frost in the shade. The bus queue has moved into the sun.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-004.text: Inkungu enkulu edamini namuhla ekuseni. Izinhlanzi zibona into efanayo nawe.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-004.en: Thick mist on the dam this morning. The fish have the same view as you.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-005.en: The hadedas are heading home early. Follow them.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-006.text: Kuyabanda, kumanzi futhi kumpunga. Imoto inuka uviniga. Kulungile.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-006.en: Cold, wet and grey. The car smells of vinegar. Correct.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-007.text: Umoya omkhulu namuhla. Isihlahla sika-avocado sine-sale enkulu.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-007.en: Big wind today. The avo tree is having a clearance sale.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-008.text: Inkungu enkulu namuhla ekuseni. Izicabucabu bezilokhu zimatasa sonke isikhathi.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-008.en: Thick mist this morning. The spiders have been busy all along.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-009.text: Kushisa kakhulu: unompempe ubiza ikhefu lamanzi njalo ngemizuzu eyishumi.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-009.en: Hot enough that the ref's calling a water break every ten minutes.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-010.text: Kubanda futhi kumanzi usuku lonke. Ifenisha isisondele kancane kancane ku-heater.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-010.en: Cold and wet all day. The furniture has slowly moved closer to the heater.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-011.text: Isaqhwithi sokwenene ngobu busuku. Ukuba urhuqa i-caravan, i-caravan yiyo eqhubayo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-011.en: Proper gale tonight. If you're towing a caravan, the caravan is driving.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-012.text: Kushushu ngokwenene emva kwemini. Nditsho namakhandlela akakwazi ukuma ethe nkqo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-012.en: Proper heat this afternoon. Even the candles can't stand up straight.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-013.text: Iqabaka emthunzini. Umgca webhasi ungene elangeni.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-013.en: Frost in the shade. The bus queue has moved into the sun.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-014.text: Inkungu eshinyeneyo edamini ngale ntsasa. Iintlanzi zibona into efanayo nawe.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-014.en: Thick mist on the dam this morning. The fish have the same view as you.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-015.en: The hadedas are heading home early. Follow them.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-016.text: Kuyabanda, kumanzi kwaye kungwevu. Imoto inuka iviniga. Kulungile.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-016.en: Cold, wet and grey. The car smells of vinegar. Correct.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-017.text: Umoya omkhulu namhlanje. Umthi we-avocado unentengiso enkulu.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-017.en: Big wind today. The avo tree is having a clearance sale.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-018.text: Inkungu eshinyeneyo ngale ntsasa. Izigcawu bezisoloko zixakekile ixesha lonke.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-018.en: Thick mist this morning. The spiders have been busy all along.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-019.text: Kushushu kangangokuba usompempe ubiza ikhefu lamanzi rhoqo emva kwemizuzu elishumi.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-019.en: Hot enough that the ref's calling a water break every ten minutes.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-020.text: Kuyabanda kwaye kumanzi imini yonke. Ifenitshala isondele kancinci kancinci kwi-heater.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-020.en: Cold and wet all day. The furniture has slowly moved closer to the heater.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-021.text: Maru a seng makae a tlile ho shebella. Le ona ha a kenele mabelo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-021.en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-022.text: Sefefo se senyenyane sa lerole se mo etella pele. Sona ha se kgatake dipedale le ho hang.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-022.en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-023.text: Moya o lekaneng bosiung bona. Menang ha a kgone ho lula fatshe.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-023.en: A proper breeze tonight. The mosquitoes have been grounded.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-024.text: Moya o moholo kajeno. Sefate sa avo se rekisa tsohle ka theko e tlase.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-024.en: Big wind today. The avo tree is having a clearance sale.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-025.text: Lehodimo le hlakile hoseng hona. Mang kapa mang ya kgannang a lebile botjhabela o kganna ka hlooho.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-025.en: Clear sky this morning. Anyone driving east is doing it from memory.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-026.text: Leru hodima thaba, potjie tlasa lapa. Ka bobedi di hloka hora e nngwe.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-026.en: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-027.text: Maru thapama yohle, ha ho lerothodi le le leng. Hose e kgutlela mosebetsing.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-027.en: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The hose is back on duty.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-028.text: Maru bakeng sa ho dikela ha letsatsi, di-sprinkler bakeng sa merara. Polasi e iketsetsa pula ya yona.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-028.en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-029.text: Ho bata ebile ho kolobile letsatsi lohle. Thepa ya ka tlung e atametse heater butle-butle.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-029.en: Cold and wet all day. The furniture has slowly moved closer to the heater.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-030.text: Ho a bata, ho kolobile, ho putswa. Koloi e nkga asene. Ho nepahetse.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-030.en: Cold, wet and grey. The car smells of vinegar. Correct.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-031.text: Esita le hadeda e kgutsitse. Lehodimo le bontshitse tsela.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-031.en: Even the hadeda is keeping it down. The sky set the tone.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-032.text: Esita le batho ba hlapanyang hore ha ho mohla ho batang ba a dumela kajeno.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-032.en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-033.text: Lebone le leng le le leng moleng le a thekesela. Bosiu ba Moqebelo bo na le morethetho, hanyane feela.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-033.en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-034.text: Difolaga di otlolohile, veine e tshwerwe ka thata. Ke Mantaha o kgutsitseng ho ya ka deck.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-034.en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-035.text: Serame moriting. Mola wa bese o kene letsatsing.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-035.en: Frost in the shade. The bus queue has moved into the sun.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-036.text: Pula e ntle. Ntatemoholo o se a letsetsa bohle: 'Le fumane bokae?'
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-036.en: Good rain. Oupa's already phoning round: 'How much did you get?'

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-037.text: Lehodimo le putswa, di-jersey di apere, sekolo se tswile. Mafelo a beke ha a hloke tumello ya letsatsi.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-037.en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-038.text: Halofo ya kgwedi, halofo ya leru, bin e tletse. Bosiu ba Labobedi, jwalo ka ha ho boletswe.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-038.en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-039.text: Halofo ya dinaledi e ka mora maru. Mabone a manyane a a di emela.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-039.en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-040.text: Letsoho hodima kepisi, mohato ka mohato. Moya o mo behela lebelo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-040.en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze is pacing her.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-041.text: Ho tjhesa hoo moahlodi a bitsang phomolo ya metsi metsotso e meng le e meng e leshome.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-041.en: Hot enough that the ref's calling a water break every ten minutes.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-042.text: Letsatsi le ne le kena le tswa letsatsi lohle, mme jwale sena. Bohle re tseba motho ya jwalo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-042.en: In and out of the sun all day, then this. We all know someone like that.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-043.text: Ke hora ya botshelela hoseng mme fridge e se e le kamore e ratwang ka ho fetisisa ka tlung.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-043.en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-044.text: Esale ho shebahala eka pula e tla na ho tloha dijong tsa hoseng. E ntse e shebahala feela.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-044.en: It's looked like rain since breakfast. Still just looking.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-045.text: Kgwedi ka mora leru, ntja stoepong. Tshebeletso ya Sontaha e fedile.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-045.en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-046.text: Boholo ba nako ho na le letsatsi. Ntle le hodima serapa sa hao.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-046.en: Mostly sunny. Except over your garden.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-047.text: Ha ho meriti, ha ho kganya, ha ho mabaka. Mantaha tlasa sekwahelo sa Tupperware.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-047.en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-048.text: Ha ho leru letsatsi lohle. Sefate se le seng feela sebakeng sa ho paka se se se le thepa ya bohlokwa.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-048.en: Not a cloud all day. The only tree in the car park is now prime property.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-049.text: Ha ho moriti le o mong lebaleng letsatsi lohle. Moahlodi ha a ka a ba le bothata ba kganya.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-049.en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-050.text: Leru le le leng hodima thaba hase ketsahalo ya boemo ba lehodimo. Mollo o ntse o tuka.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-050.en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-051.text: Moya o matla haholo bosiung bona. Haeba o hula caravan, caravan ke yona e kgannang.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-051.en: Proper gale tonight. If you're towing a caravan, the caravan is driving.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-052.text: Mocheso wa nnete thapama ena. Esita le dikerese ha di kgone ho ema di otlolohile.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-052.en: Proper heat this afternoon. Even the candles can't stand up straight.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-053.text: Ho bata ka nnete kajeno. Serame se kenang di-jersey tse tharo eka ha di eo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-053.en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-054.text: Pherese fatshe, bosweu lehodimong. Mebala ya Labohlano e amohetswe.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-054.en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-055.text: Pula e na bosiu bohle. Sprinkler ha e eso lemohe.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-055.en: Raining all night. The sprinkler hasn't noticed.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-056.text: Lewatle le lehodimo di putswa ka ho tshwana. Ke mabone a pier feela a entseng boiteko.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-056.en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-057.text: Dieta di tshwere kobo hore e se ke ya fofa. Moya o a amohelwa, lehlabathe ha le amohelwe.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-057.en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-058.text: Lehodimo le lewatle di dumellane ka mmala hoseng hona. Ha se o thabisang.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-058.en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-059.text: Motho e mong o lebetse diaparo tse hlatswitsweng. Moya ha o a lebala, mme o etsa mosebetsi hantle.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-059.en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's doing a lovely job.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-060.text: Moya o tsitsitseng o tswa ho braai ya baahisane. O fumana tsohle ntle le nama.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-060.en: Steady breeze from next door's braai. You get everything but the meat.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-061.text: Letsatsi le a kena, le a tswa. Mantaha o qala butle.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-061.en: Sun's in, sun's out. Monday's doing a soft launch.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-062.text: Di-sunglasses ho apara, ho hlobola, ho apara. Thapama ya Labohlano ke boikwetliso.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-062.en: Sunglasses on, sunglasses off, sunglasses on. Friday afternoon is interval training.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-063.text: Moya o etsa mosebetsi wohle. Khaete e nka tlotla yohle.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-063.en: The breeze does all the work. The kite takes all the credit.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-064.text: Moya o isa jacaranda seterateng se latelang, lekgasi ka lekgasi. Stoep e a dumela.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-064.en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-065.text: Moya o ntse o futhumetse ka nako ena. Lewatle le siya heater e butswe bosiu bohle.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-065.en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-066.text: Moya o isa mosi tlase seterateng. Seterata kaofela se tseba hore ho jewang mantsiboya.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-066.en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-067.text: Maru a feta butle-butle. Ke Sontaha; a dumelletswe.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-067.en: The clouds are drifting through slowly. It's Sunday; they're allowed.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-068.text: Maru a bapala ka kgwedi. Balcony e thabela ho ema.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-068.en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-069.text: Maru a file letsatsi phomolo ka Labobedi. Ha ho ya boleletseng mongobo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-069.en: The clouds gave the sun Tuesday off. Nobody told the humidity.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-070.text: Maru a diehile feela bakeng sa mebala. Mantaha o ne a re kolota seo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-070.en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-071.text: Maru a fetohile pinki hantle nakong ya ho phutha thoto. Ha ho ya phuthileng.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-071.en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-072.text: Folaga ya hukung e bontsha hantle moo bolo e tla kgelohela teng.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-072.en: The corner flag is pointing out exactly where the conversions will drift.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-073.text: Ntja e fumane mola o nepahetseng pakeng tsa letsatsi le moriti. E dula moo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-073.en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-074.text: Lerole le kganya jwalo ka kgauta leseding le tlase. Papadi e tswela pele ka hare ho lona.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-074.en: The dust is going for gold in the low light. The match plays on through it.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-075.text: Folaga e fana ka ponelopele pele ho ba-surfer. E re: tsamayang.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-075.en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-076.text: Difolaga di ntse di qoqa. Diketswana di phethile beke.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-076.en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-077.text: Dihadeda di ya hae kapele. Di latele.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-077.en: The hadedas are heading home early. Follow them.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-078.text: Leralla le tsamaya ka maqhubu. Dikgomo di nkile qeto ya ho se lemohe.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-078.en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-079.text: Makgasi a jacaranda le ona a palama bese. Moya o a rekeletse ditekete.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-079.en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-080.text: Makgasi a ntse a bonesa lebone la tshireletso. Ntja e se e kgaotse ho tsoha bakeng sa ona.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-080.en: The leaves keep setting off the security light. The dog's stopped getting up for them.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-081.text: Kgwedi e hlaha pakeng tsa maru. E kgona ho nkga nama ho tswa hodimo kwana.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-081.en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-082.text: Kgwedi e ntse e hlaha ho tla hlahloba forecourt. Ha ho letho le etsahalang.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-082.en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-083.text: Kgwedi e fokotsehile leseding bosiung bona. Lebone la tshireletso lona ha le tsebe ho fokotseha.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-083.en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-084.text: Thaba e ikwahetse kobo hlooho. Ho lokile, ke Labohlano.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-084.en: The mountain pulled the duvet over its head. Fair enough, it's Friday.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-085.text: Lehlabathe le tshela tsela butle-butle. Ha ho motho ya potlakileng mona.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-085.en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-086.text: Lebone la tshireletso le qadile ho kganya kapele. Letsatsi ha le a ka la fihla mosebetsing hantle.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-086.en: The security light came on early. The sun never properly clocked in.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-087.text: Moriti o theoha mela ka mola. O a hlahloba.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-087.en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-088.text: Lebone la shede ke ho dikela ha letsatsi bosiung bona. Dikgomo di amohela phokotso eo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-088.en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-089.text: Dilakane di se di omme. Jwale moya o iponahatsa feela bakeng sa ngwana.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-089.en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-090.text: Lehodimo le fetohile ho tloha ho putswa bo bobebe ho ya ho putswa bo lefifi. Ke yona pontsho yohle.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-090.en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-091.text: Lehodimo le kgutsitse, le mola o kgutsitse. Mantaha ha a eso fumane modumo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-091.en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found the volume.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-092.text: Lehodimo le bontsha pontsho. Ditlhapi, jwalo ka mehla, ha di etse jwalo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-092.en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-093.text: Mosi o fumane jarete ya baahisane. Braai ya Moqebelo ke ketsahalo ya setjhaba ka molao.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-093.en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-094.text: Letsatsi ha le a ka la hlaha bakeng sa di-sundowner. Bohle ba bang ba tlile.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-094.en: The sun didn't show for sundowners. Everyone else did.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-095.text: Letsatsi le ke ke la hlahloba ho benya kajeno. Koloi e kgotsofetse ke seo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-095.en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-096.text: Letsatsi le phethile mosebetsi. Maru a ntse a kganya, le balcony e ntse e kganya.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-096.en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-097.text: Diaparo di ne di lokela ho kenngwa dihora tse fetileng. Moya o voutetse hore di sale.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-097.en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-098.text: Diaparo di tla be di omme pele ho phomolo ya pele. Moya o nkile shift ya hoseng.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-098.en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-099.text: Naha yohle e fokoditswe mebala. Dinku di balwa ka ho tshwana ho sa tsotellehe.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-099.en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-100.text: Pompo ya moya ha e dumele nakong ya ho tlohela mosebetsi. Le ntja ha e dumele.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-100.en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-101.text: Pompo ya moya e etsa mosebetsi wa hoseng. Jwang bo e kgothatsa feela.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-101.en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-102.text: Mohodi o motenya letamong hoseng hona. Ditlhapi di bona se tshwanang le seo o se bonang.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-102.en: Thick mist on the dam this morning. The fish have the same view as you.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-103.text: Mohodi o motenya hoseng hona. Dikgo di ne di ntse di sebetsa nako yohle.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-103.en: Thick mist this morning. The spiders have been busy all along.

hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-104.text: Maru ao a feta feela. Esita le poone e a tseba hore e se ke ya thaba haholo.
hero-pairs-b-and-st-01-104.en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.
